items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I came through with Oliver Shaw, I played Phoenix

ctx.x: Oh, that -- it's funny that it would be the second oldest and not the oldest. The oldest was all right, huh?
Well, the oldest was -- yeah, the oldest was a couple of years later he was in Phoenix and I came through with Oliver Shaw, I played Phoenix, it was a real small town, he was living there.
